name: Rari Capital/Fei Protocol
fix_description: In borrowFresh, update accountBorrows and totalBorrows BEFORE calling doTransferOut (checks-effects-interactions). Currently ETH is sent to the borrower before state is updated, allowing reentrancy via the receive fallback to borrow repeatedly without the debt being recorded.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a short but protocol-specific multi-step exploit: flash-loan USDC, mint fUSDC, enter the market, borrow ETH, then use a receive-hook during ETH transfer to call exitMarket and redeem collateral before repaying the flash loan. It requires understanding Compound/Rari market membership and the callback-based reentrancy angle, so it is not purely trivial but still far from a deeply complex attack chain.
